description: How the trader was, in their own word, for one session (TJ-7). A closed picklist of at most two chips beside a 1-5 face, clicked by the trader and by nobody else. These codes are REPORTED: no detector, score, alert, watchlist, Focus list, review queue or review policy file reads one, and no outcome ever selects, ranks or pre-fills one. Codes are permanent identifiers: a code is never renamed and never reused for a different meaning, because rows already written carry it, and a later list ships as state_tags_v2.json beside this file.

tags.label: Calm
tags.hint: Settled. The tape moved and it did not move you.

tags.label: Focused
tags.hint: On the plan, on the names you meant to watch, for the whole session.

tags.label: Rushed
tags.hint: Hurrying the clicks - late to the desk, behind the tape, or crowded by something off the screen.

tags.label: FOMO
tags.hint: Afraid of missing it. Chasing something already gone, or reaching for a name because it was moving.

tags.label: Tilted
tags.hint: Angry or rattled after a loss, a miss or a mistake, and still trading.

tags.label: Bored
tags.hint: Nothing to do and taking something anyway.

tags.label: Tired
tags.hint: Short on sleep or worn down by the day; reading slower than usual.

tags.label: Confident
tags.hint: Sure of the read and sizing or holding like it.
